patterns.note: Content is consistently centered within a generous maximum width, creating ample whitespace around text and UI elements.
A single sans-serif typeface (Inter) is used throughout, with clear hierarchy established through significant size and weight variations for headings, subheadings, and body text.
The palette is dominated by warm, muted off-white and beige tones for backgrounds and surfaces, contrasted with a dark brown for all primary text and call-to-action buttons.
Subtle 3D letter tiles float and parallax gently in the background as the user scrolls, adding a dynamic yet non-distracting visual texture.
The simulated macOS window UI element dynamically updates its displayed content as the user scrolls, showcasing different product interactions and features.
Major content blocks are clearly delineated by large, bold headings and significant vertical spacing, creating distinct narrative sections on the single page.

technique_notes: The background features animated 3D letter tiles that subtly parallax as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic yet unobtrusive visual texture. This effect is powered by WebGL/Three.js, with elements moving at different speeds relative to the scroll position.

Key information is presented within a simulated operating system window UI, which updates its internal content to showcase different features or use cases as the user scrolls down the page, effectively acting as a scroll-triggered content carousel.
Content sections appear with a subtle fade-in or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, drawing attention to new information.

design_tokens.type_scale: oversized, bold headings (~3-4x body text) with a clear, legible body text size.
design_tokens.radius: subtle rounding on interactive elements like buttons, input fields, and the simulated Mac window.
design_tokens.spacing: very airy, especially in the hero and between major sections, creating a sense of calm and focus.

standout: The most distinctive elements are the animated 3D floating letter tiles in the background, which provide a playful and unique texture without distracting from the content. The simulated Mac window UI element that dynamically updates its content on scroll is also a clever way to demonstrate the product's functionality.
